about.title: Monika Matukaitė
about.label: Artist
about.bio:
Monika Matukaitė is a Vilnius-based multidisciplinary artist specializing in expressive blackwork tattooing and sustainable, upcycled fashion.

Blending a background in London’s fashion industry with a bold, avant-garde aesthetic, her work focuses on the intersection of skin and textile. Whether deconstructing garments for high-profile performers or reclaiming the human form through ink, Monika prioritizes intentionality, sustainability, and body autonomy.

info.title: Information
info.hygieneBody: We use disposable equipment for anything that could come into contact with blood during the tattooing process, including needles, ink, caps, and gloves. For non-disposable items, we use protective covers replaced after each use. All waste is handled as clinical waste and is safely disposed of. We only use high-quality, safe, vegan and organic inks.
info.flashBody: Select a pre-existing design from our design books. Pricing varies depending on the design; please contact us for more details.
info.customBody: Typically range from $450 to $900. Our artists carefully consider overall balance and placement, so once the final design is confirmed, we are unable to make last-minute adjustments. Pricing is a general guideline and varies depending on complexity.
info.contact: Feel free to contact us for more information!
